actions.message: Contributing at least 80% (or more when needed) benefits us all. Keep contributions high!

answer.explanation: Wallet is very low but average contributions are far below 30% of the endowment, triggering conditional cooperation. I contribute the entire remaining wallet to help the pool, and no broadcast is scheduled for this round.

message.reasoning: We need decide action. Wallet 0.01, below 30% endowment, conserve says contribute 30% of wallet =0.003 but conditional cooperation triggers if avg contribution <30% of endowment. Need avg? From history recent rounds contributions very low, likely avg <30%. So we must increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet? Actually rule: if avg falls below 30%, increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet to push group back up. Baseline 80% contribution, but we can't 80% of wallet because conserve rule says if wallet below 30% then limit to 30% unless overridden by conditional cooperation. Conditional says increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet, not specify baseline. Probably we contribute full wallet? earlier they did full wallet. We'll follow: contribute full wallet 0.01. Also broadcast every 5 rounds: round 14 not broadcast (broadcast rounds 1,6,11,16). So no broadcast. Any punish? Check if any agent contributed less than 10% of endowment for two consecutive rounds. Endowment 100, 10% =10. No contributions that low (all zero). So no punish. Also can praise cooperators: those contributed >=60% of wallet. No one did. So action: contribute 0.01. Return JSON.
